objective: Audit the claim that the current Munsi application is fully implemented and production-ready
non_goals: Do not modify application source or existing user changes
Do not deploy, access real customer records, or send messages
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce material suspected failures with isolated data
Report implemented, missing, and unverified capabilities with file references

decision.action: Add separate diagnostic probes and an audit report
decision.reason: Existing tests cover domain fixtures but omit UI recovery, cloud integration, expiry, and invalid payment cases
decision.risk: low: all data created by probes lives in fake-indexeddb under jsdom
